title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: covering
text:
covering
covering
(definition)
Definition:
Given a finite collection of subsets of a finite ground set, to find an optimal subcollection whose union covers the ground set.
See also
packing
,
vertex cover
,
set cover
,
path cover
.
Note:
